2608.14161.title: BiasTrace: Linking Reasoning Behaviours to Biased Outputs in LLMs
2608.14161.paper_summary: LLMs exhibit social biases that can produce inaccurate and discriminatory inferences, posing risks in high-stakes applications. While prior work has made progress in measuring and mitigating bias, it largely focuses on final outputs of models, with limited understanding of the mechanisms that produce biased outcomes. Recent advances in LLM reasoning offers a new lens for investigating bias, yet the link between reasoning and bias remains poorly understood. Existing approaches focus primarily on final answer correctness or explicitly biased language, overlooking different behaviours in reasoning that can drive biased outcomes. We introduce BiasTrace, an annotation scheme for labelling reasoning behaviours in model-generated traces and linking them to biased outcomes. BiasTrace captures bias-specific behaviours (e.g., unsupported demographic assumptions) as well as general reasoning patterns that may implicitly contribute to bias (e.g. overthinking). We apply BiasTrace to reasoning traces in bias-sensitive contexts, scaled using validated LLM-as-a-judge methods, producing a large annotated dataset. Our analysis shows that biased outputs often stem from subtle reasoning behaviours rather than explicitly biased language, and that reasoning-level annotations improve bias detection. We further show that BiasTrace behaviours can be exploited for inference-time mitigation. These findings underscore the importance of examining a broader range of reasoning patterns to better understand bias in LLMs.
2608.14161.paper_summary_zh: LLMs 展現出社會偏見，可能產生不準確和歧視性的推論，對於高風險的應用構成風險。<lb/>雖然先前的研究在測量和減輕偏見方面取得了一定進展，但主要集中在模型的最終輸出上，對產生偏見結果的機制理解有限。<lb/>最近在 LLM 推理方面的進展提供了一個新的視角來調查偏見，但推理與偏見之間的聯繫仍然不甚清楚。<lb/>現有的方法主要集中在最終答案的正確性或明顯的偏見語言上，忽略了推理中可能驅動偏見結果的不同行為。<lb/>我們引入了 BiasTrace，一種標註模型生成的推理行為並將其與偏見結果聯繫起來的標註方案。<lb/>BiasTrace 捕捉特定於偏見的行為（例如，無支持的群體假設）以及可能隱含地促成偏見的一般推理模式（例如，過度思考）。<lb/>我們將 BiasTrace 應用於偏見敏感背景中的推理痕跡，使用經過驗證的 LLM 作為評判者的方法進行擴展，產生了一個大型標註數據集。<lb/>我們的分析顯示，偏見輸出通常源於微妙的推理行為，而不是明顯的偏見語言，並且推理層級的標註能改善偏見檢測。<lb/>我們進一步表明，BiasTrace 行為可以被利用於推論時的減輕。<lb/>這些發現強調了檢視更廣泛的推理模式以更好地理解 LLM 中的偏見的重要性。
